tasks.behavior: V4 usable-diagram gates: reachable chrome, one presentation contract, structured icons, sequence editor geometry, mode chooser, and honest packaged-CLI status.
acceptance: Header actions collapse from content, not only a 390px rule; More/menus/selects render outside clipped ancestors and dismiss with Escape, outside click, and focus return.
Node inspector always has a visible Close; phone outline and details are dismissible overlays that keep selection and camera.
Minus, zoom percent, plus, Fit all, and Focus share one viewport toolbar; the percent does not cover a button.
Editor, SVG, PNG, and HTML use one kind/title/icon/padding contract; sequence editor draws lifelines and ordered message routes instead of remapping them onto node handles.
New offers a mode choice; inspector fields and add/connect options follow the document kind; skill and docs do not claim npm 0.1.0 validates sequence/data-flow/lifecycle.
Rename overlap surfaces a local repair preview; keyboard command palette can find components; remaining parity rows stay listed as outstanding.
